question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Ace in the hole

options.text: A second chance to do something

solution:
The correct answer is: **A hidden advantage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Ace in the hole"** means a hidden advantage or a resource kept in reserve, especially one that is revealed at a crucial moment. (गुप्त लाभ)

 
 
• **Example:** She always has an **ace in the hole** during negotiations, which is why she often comes out on top.
 
 
 
• **"Hidden advantage"** refers to an asset or piece of information that is kept secret until it is needed to gain an advantage. (गुप्त लाभ)
 
 
• **Example:** The company's new product line was their **hidden advantage** in the competitive market.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A second chance to do something** (कुछ करने का दूसरा मौका): An opportunity to try again after a failure.

 
 
• **Example:** He got **a second chance to do the project** after his initial failure.
 
 
 
• **A lot to do** (बहुत कुछ करना): Having many tasks or responsibilities.
 
 
• **Example:** She has **a lot to do** before the deadline tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **On the point of** (के बिंदु पर): About to do something or very close to a particular moment.
 
 
• **Example:** He was **on the point of** leaving when the phone rang.
